import {
  MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial,
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial,
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, color, smoothstep, float } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, Shape, ExtrudeGeometry, PlaneGeometry, SpotLight, PointLight, AmbientLight, Object3D, Color, CircleGeometry } = ctx.THREE;

  const PALETTE = {
    background: '#0b0b10',
    surface: '#14141a',
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    inactive: '#a6adba',
    gradTop: '#1b1b23',
    gradBottom: '#101015',
  };

  const root = new Group();
  root.name = 'nav-dock';
  const timelines = [];
  const disposables = [];

  // ---------- stageBackdrop: graded stage, never void ----------
  function stageBackdrop() {
    const geo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
    const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
    const v = uv().y;
    // vertical gradient gradientStops #1b1b23 (bottom-ish glow center) -> #101015, vignetted into background #0b0b10
    const grad = mix(color(PALETTE.gradBottom), color(PALETTE.gradTop), smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, v));
    const cx = uv().x.sub(0.5).mul(2.0);
    const cy = uv().y.sub(0.5).mul(2.0);
    const r = cx.mul(cx).add(cy.mul(cy));
    const vig = smoothstep(1.6, 0.2, r);
    mat.colorNode = mix(color(PALETTE.background), grad, vig.mul(0.85).add(0.15));
    const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
    disposables.push(geo, mat);
    return mesh;
  }
  root.add(stageBackdrop());

  // ---------- lightRig: rig-product-hero, node-local, subject radius ~1.8 ----------
  function lightRig() {
    const g = new Group();
    const R = 1.8;
    const amb = new AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.1);
    g.add(amb);

    const keyTarget = new Object3D();
    keyTarget.position.set(0, 0.5 * R * 0.3, 0);
    g.add(keyTarget);
    const key = new SpotLight(0xfff2e0, 65, 0, 0.5, 0.55, 2);
    key.position.set(2.2 * R, 3.2 * R, 2.4 * R);
    key.target = keyTarget;
    g.add(key);

    const fill = new PointLight(0xd8dde6, 4, 9, 2);
    fill.position.set(-2.8 * R, 0.9 * R, 2 * R);
    g.add(fill);

    const rimTarget = new Object3D();
    rimTarget.position.set(0, 0.7 * R * 0.3, 0);
    g.add(rimTarget);
    const rim = new SpotLight(0xffffff, 48, 0, 0.6, 0.4, 2);
    rim.position.set(-1.6 * R, 2.6 * R, -2.2 * R);
    rim.target = rimTarget;
    g.add(rim);
    return g;
  }
  root.add(lightRig());

  // ---------- dock group (rises in) ----------
  const dock = new Group();
  dock.position.z = 0.15;
  root.add(dock);

  // ---------- railMesh: machined rail 3.6 x 0.5, radius 0.1, chamfer 0.02 ----------
  function railMesh() {
    const w = 3.6, h = 0.5, r = 0.1;
    const shape = new Shape();
    const x = -w / 2, y = -h / 2;
    shape.moveTo(x + r, y);
    shape.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    shape.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    shape.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    shape.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    shape.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    shape.lineTo(x, y + r);
    shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    const geo = new ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
      depth: 0.08,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelThickness: 0.02,
      bevelSize: 0.02,
      bevelSegments: 3,
      curveSegments: 12,
    });
    geo.translate(0, 0, -0.08);

    const mat = new MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial({
      roughness: 0.55,
      metalness: 0.5,
      clearcoat: 0.2,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.35,
    });
    // vertical albedo ramp #1b1b23 -> #101015 + subtle brushed streaks along x (anisotropy 0.6 read)
    const vy = uv().y;
    const ramp = mix(color(PALETTE.gradTop), color(PALETTE.gradBottom), vy);
    const streak = uv().x.mul(240.0).sin().mul(0.5).add(0.5).mul(0.04);
    mat.colorNode = ramp.add(vec3(streak, streak, streak));
    mat.roughnessNode = float(0.55).sub(streak.mul(0.6));
    if ('anisotropy' in mat) mat.anisotropy = 0.6;

    disposables.push(geo, mat);

  dock.add(rail);

  // ---------- contactShadow: radial shadow plane, opacity 0.35, offset 0.06 down ----------
  function contactShadow() {
    const geo = new PlaneGeometry(4.6, 1.1);
    const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
    const cx = uv().x.sub(0.5).mul(2.0);
    const cy = uv().y.sub(0.5).mul(2.0);
    const d = cx.mul(cx).add(cy.mul(cy).mul(2.2));
    mat.colorNode = vec3(0, 0, 0);
    mat.opacityNode = smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, d).mul(0.35);
    const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.position.set(0, -0.06 - 0.28, -0.14);
    disposables.push(geo, mat);
    return mesh;
  }
  root.add(contactShadow());

  // ---------- navEntries: five cells, MSDF text, active underline ----------
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const labels = items.length
    ? items.map((i) => ({ text: String(i.text), role: i.role ?? 'nav-item' }))
    : [
        { text: 'HOME', role: 'nav-active' },
        { text: 'FEATURES', role: 'nav-item' },
        { text: 'COLLECTION', role: 'nav-item' },
        { text: 'PRICING', role: 'nav-item' },
        { text: 'JOURNAL', role: 'nav-item' },
      ];
  const targets = ['hub-home', 'hub-features', 'hub-collection', 'hub-pricing', 'hub-journal'];

  const SPACING = 0.68;
  const startX = -SPACING * (labels.length - 1) / 2;
  const cells = [];
  let activeIndex = labels.findIndex((l) => l.role === 'nav-active');
  if (activeIndex < 0) activeIndex = 0;

  const hitGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.6, 0.34);
  disposables.push(hitGeo);

  function navEntries() {
    labels.forEach((label, i) => {
      const cell = new Group();
      cell.position.set(startX + i * SPACING, 0, 0.06);

      const isActive = i === activeIndex;
      const textObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(label.text, {
        fontSize: 13,
        color: isActive ? PALETTE.paper : PALETTE.inactive,
        align: 'center',
        letterSpacingPx: 13 * 0.08,
      });
      cell.add(textObj);

      // invisible hit plane (0.6 x 0.34 hit cell, 0.25 inner padding respected by text width)
      const hitMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, opacity: 0 });
      hitMat.opacityNode = float(0);
      const hit = new Mesh(hitGeo, hitMat);
      hit.position.z = 0.01;
      hit.userData.navIndex = i;
      cell.add(hit);
      disposables.push(hitMat);

      dock.add(cell);
      cells.push({ cell, textObj, hit, index: i });
    });

  navEntries();

  // ---------- underlineBar: accent emissive bar, focal element ----------
  function underlineBar() {
    const geo = new PlaneGeometry(0.28, 0.025);
    const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
    mat.colorNode = color(PALETTE.accent).mul(1.8); // emissive intensity 1.8, under 2.3 cap
    const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
    // seated 0.06 below baseline (text centered at y=0, fontSize ~0.13 units)
    mesh.position.set(startX + activeIndex * SPACING, -0.06 - 0.075, 0.09);
    disposables.push(geo, mat);
    return mesh;
  }
  const underline = underlineBar();
  dock.add(underline);

  // faint accent glow halo behind underline (keeps accent <=10% of frame)
  const glowGeo = new CircleGeometry(0.22, 24);
  const glowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  const gd = uv().sub(0.5).length().mul(2.0);
  glowMat.colorNode = color(PALETTE.accent);
  glowMat.opacityNode = smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, gd).mul(0.18);

  glow.position.copy(underline.position);
  glow.position.z -= 0.005;
  dock.add(glow);
  disposables.push(glowGeo, glowMat);

  // ---------- motion: mount rise-in + settle ----------
  function mountRise() {
    const tl = gsap.timeline();
    dock.position.y = -0.4;
    tl.to(dock.position, { y: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out' });
    tl.fromTo(dock.scale, { x: 1.04, y: 1.04 }, { x: 1, y: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out' }, 0.4);
    timelines.push(tl);
  }
  mountRise();

  // ---------- interactions ----------
  function setActive(next) {
    if (next === activeIndex) return;
    const prev = cells[activeIndex];
    const cur = cells[next];
    activeIndex = next;
    // recolor via recreate-free tint if supported; fall back to material color
    const fade = (obj, hex) => {
      obj.traverse((c) => {
        if (c.material && c.material.color) {
          const target = new Color(hex);
          const tl = gsap.to(c.material.color, { r: target.r, g: target.g, b: target.b, duration: 0.16, ease: 'power2.out' });
          timelines.push(tl);
        }
      });
    };
    fade(prev.textObj, PALETTE.inactive);
    fade(cur.textObj, PALETTE.paper);
    const x = startX + next * SPACING;
    const tl = gsap.timeline();
    tl.to([underline.position, glow.position], { x, duration: 0.26, ease: 'back.out(1.04)' });
    timelines.push(tl);
  }

  function indexFromEvent(e) {
    let o = e?.object ?? e?.target ?? null;
    while (o) {
      if (o.userData && o.userData.navIndex !== undefined) return o.userData.navIndex;
      o = o.parent;
    }
    return null;
  }

  root.userData.handlers = {
    hover(e) {
      const i = indexFromEvent(e);
      cells.forEach(({ cell, textObj, index }) => {
        const hovering = index === i;
        if (index !== activeIndex) {
          textObj.traverse((c) => {
            if (c.material && c.material.color) {
              const target = new Color(hovering ? PALETTE.paper : PALETTE.inactive);
              const tl = gsap.to(c.material.color, { r: target.r, g: target.g, b: target.b, duration: 0.16, ease: 'power2.out' });
              timelines.push(tl);
            }
          });
        }
        const tl = gsap.to(cell.rotation, { x: hovering ? -0.06 : 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' });
        timelines.push(tl);
      });
    },
    click(e) {
      const i = indexFromEvent(e);
      if (i === null) return;
      const { cell } = cells[i];
      const tl = gsap.timeline();
      tl.to(cell.scale, { x: 0.97, y: 0.97, duration: 0.12, ease: 'back.out(1.275)' });
      tl.to(cell.position, { z: 0.03, duration: 0.12, ease: 'back.out(1.275)' }, 0);
      tl.to(cell.scale, { x: 1, y: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out' });
      tl.to(cell.position, { z: 0.06, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out' }, '<');
      timelines.push(tl);
      setActive(i);
      ctx.emit('navigate', { to: targets[i] ?? targets[0] });
    },
  };

  // ---------- cleanup ----------
  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timelines.forEach((tl) => tl.kill && tl.kill());
    timelines.length = 0;
    disposables.forEach((d) => d.dispose && d.dispose());
    cells.forEach(({ textObj }) => {
      textObj.traverse((c) => {
        if (c.geometry) c.geometry.dispose();
        if (c.material) c.material.dispose && c.material.dispose();
      });
    });
  };

  return root;
}
